provenance_summary: Five photographs from Keen Decorative Concrete’s own Instagram archive. Canonical originals and the genuine cyan logo were preserved locally and on S3 with SHA256 verification. Every selected original/grade pair passed independent Luna review at 93–95/100.

luna.feedback: Clean, restrained neutral treatment with controlled warm brick and believable fence/grass color. Highlights are held and the paver texture remains legible. The ordinary driveway framing and dry lawn are source-composition limitations, not grading defects.

Subtle neutralization and gentle contrast give the stamped walkway a polished editorial finish without a crunchy HDR look. The hose, soil patch, pool, shed, grass, and compass remain naturally integrated. The busy residential scene is a source limitation.

The deeper neutral treatment controls the bright sky and gives the dark decorative surface useful separation while retaining believable brick, lawn, stone, and planting color. The wide-angle residential composition and existing dark slab are source limitations.

Controlled contrast and slightly calmer color improve the pool-deck read while retaining warm stamped concrete and natural foliage. The pre-existing clutter, exposed utility lines, and harsh sun remain source-composition conditions rather than grading failures.

Strongest v3 finish: warm sun is retained but highlights are more controlled, wood and brick separate cleanly, and the stamped patio reads rich without oversaturation. The hard split between shade and sun is inherent to the source and remains believable.
